shortDescription: Create and manage Koji build hosts

options.name: arches
options.description: The list of arches this host supports. Example: [x86_64]

options.name: capacity
options.description: Total task weight for this host. This is a float value. If unset, Koji will use the standard capacity for a host (2.0). Example: 10.0

options.name: channels
options.description: The list of channels this host should belong to. If you specify a completely new channel here, Ansible will create the channel on the hub. For example, when you set up OSBS with Koji, you must add a builder host to a new "container" channel. You can simply specify "container" in the list here, and Ansible will create the new "container" channel when it adds your host to that channel. Example: [default, createrepo]

options.name: comment
options.description: Human-readable comment explaining the current state of the host. You may write a description here explaining how this host was set up, or why this host is currently offline.

options.name: krb_principal
options.description: Set a single non-default krb principal for this host. If unset, Koji will use the standard krb principal scheme for builder accounts. Mutually exclusive with I(krb_principals).

options.name: krb_principals
options.description: Set a list of non-default krb principals for this host. If unset, Koji will use the standard krb principal scheme for builder accounts. Your Koji Hub must be v1.19 or later to use this option. Mutually exclusive with I(krb_principal).

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the Koji builder. Example: "builder1.example.com".

options.name: state
options.description: Whether to set this host as "enabled" or "disabled". If unset, this defaults to "enabled".
